1879052199.name: Ents go to War
1879052199.desc: Shakes the earth as if an Ent stamped his foot, greatly damaging several enemies.\n\nIf your target has recently been shaken by Cracked Earth, this skill deals bonus damage.

procEffects.description: DNT - Wild Sigils reduce the active cooldown of Sign of the Wild: Rage

1879073703.name: Default Melee Attack
1879073703.desc: Auto-attack when wielding only a single one-handed weapon.

1879094823.name: Ancient Craft
1879094823.desc: Debuffs enemies' armour with a handful of thrown metal.

1879096871.name: Scribe Manual: Horn
1879096871.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the horn. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879097895.name: Smothering Web
1879097895.desc:
Focusing all your energy on a single target you are able to overwhelm them beneath the weight of your webs opening the possibility of a warband manoeuver.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Applies Ensnared Effect. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 </rgb>

1879109031.name: Our Fates Entwined
1879109031.desc: Fates can be deeply linked if the Rune-keeper wishes. Reduce your fellowship's damage, but pay for it with your own morale.  Also, damage will not interrupt your inductions while the Fates are Entwined.

1879109287.name: Word of Exaltation
1879109287.desc:
Applies a bubble that briefly increases Morale. 

+Bubble potency per attunement consumed.
 
 Requires Healing Attunement.

conditionalEffects.description: Casting Words of Exaltation on a target will trigger the expiration heal of Bombastic Inspiration if present.

procEffects.description: Frost Armour: \n Healing skills have a  *  chance to apply:

1879117735.name: Brink of Victory
1879117735.desc: A potent attack dealing Light Damage to a group of enemies in front of the Warden.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879143079.name: Reversal
1879143079.desc: An attack which removes one corruption from the enemy.

procEffects.description: When enemies Block, Parry, or Evade your attacks, you have a chance of quickly following up from another angle, dealing:

1879157287.name: Archer
1879157287.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as an Archer.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879186727.name: Fear Nothing!
1879186727.desc: You feel the joy of battle coursing through your veins. You Fear Nothing!

1879210791.name: Skirmisher: Strong Pull
1879210791.desc: You pull on your bow and loose an arrow.

1879226919.name: Ring of Lightning
1879226919.desc: Utilize the power of Lightning to counter Saruman's attempts to drain this ring of its power.

1879230631.name: Eye Gouge
1879230631.desc: A swift swipe meant for the eyes.   <rgb=#00FFDD>From Stealth: Decreases target's max range on their skills for 10 seconds. \n \n Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879231271.name: Javelin and Fist
1879231271.desc: Mastery over the Javelin: Allows Warden to perform Javelin Gambits quickly.

1879231399.name: Ranged Adroit Manoeuvre
1879231399.desc: A javelin throw which lets the Warden attack more quickly for a time\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879238951.name: Simbelmynë Horse
1879238951.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879241639.name: Ballad - Chant
1879241639.desc: A chant can be a powerful force of restoring courage upon the field of battle.

1879262119.name: Command
1879262119.desc: When active, melee attacks strike with such force, enemies are driven away, allowing you to attack from range. Cries will infuriate enemies, forcing them to ride close by, allowing you to execute melee attacks. Use this skill to effectively juggle your melee and ranged attacks.

1879266855.name: Lorniel's Pendant
1879266855.desc: Golodir's daughter Lorniel fell at the gates of Carn Dûm, and he bears her pendant everywhere. Thinking on it increases his melee damage and ferocity.

1879268519.name: Decoy
1879268519.desc: Drops a decoy that draws the attention of nearby foes.

1879338919.name: Stripey Bat
1879338919.desc: Summons a friendly, furry, and striped bat.

1879360807.name: Lhingris Wormling
1879360807.desc: Brings out a Lhingris wormling to keep you company.

1879415719.name: Subtle Portent of Vitality
1879415719.desc: A quick burst of vitality, increasing your maximum morale and healing you.

1879454887.name: Guide to Cardolan
1879454887.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Herne in Cardolan.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879466279.name: Throw Bolas
1879466279.desc: Throw bolas at your target, entangling their legs and those of enemies nearby.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.

1879467815.name: Trample
1879467815.desc: You trample on your foes with your forceful attack.

procEffects.description: Bestial Fury: \n Whenever you Critically Hit with skills you gain:
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.
Vexation: \n Upon taking damage in Man form (20% chance in bear form):
Evading an attack applies an Incoming Healing bonus to you. This can only trigger once every 12 seconds.
DNT - parrying an Attack builds threat.  Evading an Attack builds Wrath.

1879480615.name: Vivid Green Snake
1879480615.desc: Summons a snake to accompany you on your travels.

1879486503.name: Water Buffalo Cow
1879486503.desc: Summons a noble water buffalo cow to accompany you on your travels.

1879495079.name: Mysteriously Full Pipe
1879495079.desc: Each time you pull out this pipe, it always seems full of a different batch of pipe-weed.

1879508007.name: Huntsman's Shot
1879508007.desc: A massively damaging shot that will bring down even the biggest enemies.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.
Huntsman's Shot and Merciful Shot deal additional damage to bleeding targets.
Merciful Shot consumes the current tier of Lingering Wound on a target, dealing bonus damage.

1879529511.name: Mottled Mirkwood Fawn
1879529511.desc: Summons a mottled Mirkwood fawn to accompany you on your travels.
